theme: Chính sách tài chính công ty

vocab.example: The new travel policy is effective from the first of November.
vocab.example_vi: Chính sách công tác mới có hiệu lực từ ngày 1 tháng 11.

vocab.example: Only the CFO can authorize payments above one billion dong.
vocab.example_vi: Chỉ giám đốc tài chính được phép duyệt khoản chi trên một tỷ đồng.

vocab.example: Taxi fares to the airport are reimbursable.
vocab.example_vi: Tiền taxi ra sân bay được hoàn ứng.

vocab.example: The daily travel allowance in Da Nang is six hundred thousand dong.
vocab.example_vi: Phụ cấp công tác mỗi ngày ở Đà Nẵng là sáu trăm nghìn đồng.

vocab.example: Overseas trips need pre-approval from your director.
vocab.example_vi: Các chuyến công tác nước ngoài cần được giám đốc phê duyệt trước.

vocab.meaning_vi: mức trần, giới hạn tối đa
vocab.example: There is a cap of one point five million per night for hotels.
vocab.example_vi: Có mức trần một triệu rưỡi mỗi đêm cho khách sạn.

vocab.example: Entertainment expenses for clients must be approved in advance.
vocab.example_vi: Chi phí tiếp khách phải được duyệt trước.

vocab.example: Please follow the new procedure when you submit a payment request.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng làm theo quy trình mới khi gửi đề nghị thanh toán.

lines.speaker: Thu (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Hi Đức, have you read the email about the new travel policy?

lines.speaker: Đức (Sales Manager)
lines.text: I saw it, but I haven't read it carefully. When is it effective?

lines.speaker: Thu (Finance Manager)
lines.text: From the first of November. The main change is the travel allowance.

lines.speaker: Đức (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Is it higher or lower than before?

lines.speaker: Thu (Finance Manager)
lines.text: A bit higher, six hundred thousand a day. Taxi fares are also reimbursable now.

lines.speaker: Đức (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Okay. What about hotels? My team often travels to Da Nang.

lines.speaker: Thu (Finance Manager)
lines.text: There is a cap of one point five million per night.

lines.speaker: Đức (Sales Manager)
lines.text: And if we take a client to dinner? Is that an entertainment expense?

lines.speaker: Thu (Finance Manager)
lines.text: Yes. It needs pre-approval, and your director must authorize it before the dinner.

lines.speaker: Đức (Sales Manager)
lines.text: Got it. I'll share the new procedure with my team this afternoon.

questions.q: When does the new policy start?
What is the hotel cap per night?
What does a client dinner need?

shadowing: Please check the new expense policy before you book your next business trip.
All purchases over ten million dong need approval from the finance manager.
Remember to keep the original receipt, or we cannot reimburse you.
The new policy is effective from next month, so please share it with your team.
If you need an exception, send a short email explaining the reason.
